pairs.rationale: Both reports describe the exact same issue: POST /api/orders endpoint returns HTTP 500 after last night's deployment, preventing order creation across web and app. inc-0001 (Spanish) and inc-0002 (English) report identical symptoms with identical timing and scope.

Both reports describe the exact same defect: clicking 'Pagar ahora'/'Place order' returns HTTP 500 and no order is created after version 4.2.0 release. inc-0001 (Spanish) and inc-0003 (English) report identical symptoms across all platforms with matching environment details.

inc-0001 reports a checkout payment failure (HTTP 500, no order created). inc-0011 reports app crashes when opening order history for users with 100+ orders. These are different features (checkout vs order history view) and different defects.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure (HTTP 500, cannot create order). inc-0013 reports order history closing the app. These are different features (checkout creation vs order history display) and different failures.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure (HTTP 500 on 'Pagar ahora'). inc-0025 reports blank screen at shipping step with TypeError about 'zones'. While both are checkout issues, they occur at different steps with different symptoms and error types.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure preventing new orders (HTTP 500). inc-0026 reports existing orders missing from order history after database migration. These are different defects: order creation vs data visibility.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure for customers (HTTP 500). inc-0031 reports admin button error for marking orders shipped. These are different features (customer checkout vs admin operations) and different defects.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure (HTTP 500, no order created). inc-0039 reports missing accents in checkout text label. These are different severity and type: functional failure vs localization/text issue.

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure (HTTP 500, version 4.2.0). inc-0044 reports iOS app crash on saved card selection (version 4.1.3). Different versions, different steps in payment flow, different root causes (server error vs mobile app crash).

inc-0001 reports checkout payment failure preventing order creation (HTTP 500). inc-0047 reports missing cancellation emails when support cancels orders. These are different defects: order creation vs post-order email notification.

inc-0001: Payment fails with 500 error, no order created. inc-0059: Expired card accepted in checkout, fails at payment. Different defects: one is a server error affecting all payments, the other is card validation.
Both report: POST /api/orders returns 500, checkout broken, no orders created, affects all users after 4.2.0 deploy. Same defect described with identical symptoms and root cause.
inc-0002: Checkout POST /api/orders fails with 500. inc-0005: Cards charged twice due to payment retry logic. Different defects: one prevents orders entirely, other causes double charges.
inc-0002: Checkout returns 500 error. inc-0011: App crashes opening order history with 100+ orders. Different features, different symptoms, different platforms/versions.
inc-0002: Checkout returns 500 error after 4.2.0 deploy. inc-0013: App crashes opening order history. Same app crash symptom but different feature and environment.
inc-0002: Checkout broken, 500 error, orders not created. inc-0023: Partner missing webhooks for order.created. Different defects: one prevents order creation, other prevents webhook delivery.
inc-0002: Checkout POST /api/orders returns 500 after deploy. inc-0024: Webhook dispatcher shows 0 deliveries for order.created since 4.2.0 deploy. Related consequences but different defects.
inc-0002: Checkout returns 500 error. inc-0042: User sees another customer's cart data due to CDN caching. Completely different defects in different features.
inc-0002: Checkout POST returns 500, no orders created. inc-0059: Expired card accepted, fails at payment. Different defects: server error vs card validation issue.
inc-0003: Order confirmation returns 500, no order created. inc-0005: Cards charged twice from payment retry logic. Different defects: one prevents order creation, other causes duplicate charges.
inc-0003 describes HTTP 500 during order placement preventing order creation. inc-0008 describes duplicate push notifications for shipped orders. Different features and defects.
inc-0003 describes HTTP 500 during order placement preventing order creation. inc-0011 describes app crash viewing order history for users with 100+ orders. Different defects in different features.
inc-0003 describes HTTP 500 during order placement preventing order creation. inc-0013 describes app crash when opening order history for users with many orders. Different defects.
inc-0003 is HTTP 500 on order placement. inc-0023 is missing webhooks for new orders. The HTTP 500 might cause webhooks not to fire, but they describe different symptoms and root causes.

inc-0003 is HTTP 500 on order placement preventing order creation. inc-0024 is webhook dispatcher showing no deliveries for order.created events. Same root cause: orders not being created since 4.2.0.
inc-0003 is HTTP 500 preventing order creation on checkout. inc-0031 is admin 'mark as shipped' button error. Different features and functions.
inc-0003 is HTTP 500 preventing order placement. inc-0043 is search showing unavailable products. Different features.
inc-0003 is HTTP 500 preventing order placement. inc-0044 is iOS app crash selecting saved payment method. Different defects and steps to reproduce.
inc-0003 is HTTP 500 preventing order creation. inc-0047 is cancellation email not sent. Different features and defects.
inc-0004 (Spanish) and inc-0005 (English) both describe customers charged twice for one order on Mastercard after payment gateway timeout. Same defect, different language and detail level.
Both reports describe customers being charged twice for a single order (2 card charges, 1 order in system). Same defect reported in different languages/styles by customer vs internal observation.
inc-0004 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0007 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. Different features (payment vs notifications) and different types of duplication.

inc-0004 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. Different features (payment vs notifications), even though both involve duplication.

inc-0004 reports duplicate card charges for payment orders; inc-0021 reports duplicate addresses when editing saved addresses. Different features (payment vs profile management) with different defects.
Both reports describe customers charged twice for one order with single order in system. inc-0005 includes technical hypothesis about retry logic, but same underlying defect as inc-0006.
inc-0005 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0007 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. Different features and different failure modes.
inc-0005 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. Different features and different failure modes.
inc-0005 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0042 reports data caching/privacy issue with cart visibility. Different features and different defects.
inc-0005 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0047 reports missing cancellation email notification. Different features and different failure modes.
inc-0005 reports duplicate card charges during payment; inc-0059 reports expired card validation issue at checkout. Different defects in payment flow (duplicate charges vs validation).

Inc-0006 reports duplicate charges to bank account for a single order. Inc-0007 reports duplicate push notifications when orders ship. These are different defects: one involves payment processing/billing, the other involves notification delivery.

Inc-0006 reports duplicate bank charges for payment. Inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. These are separate defects in different systems (billing vs notifications), despite both involving 'duplicates'.

Inc-0007 (Spanish) and Inc-0008 (English) both describe the same defect: users receive the 'Your order is on its way' / 'Tu pedido va en camino' push notification twice for shipments. Same feature, same failure, different languages.

Inc-0007 reports duplicate push notifications on shipment. Inc-0021 reports duplicate address entries when editing saved addresses. These are different features (notifications vs address management) with different duplication mechanisms.

Inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications when orders ship. Inc-0011 reports app crashes when opening order history with 100+ orders. These are different defects in different screens with different symptoms.

Inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. Inc-0042 reports users seeing each other's cart data on shared networks. These are completely different defects in different features (notifications vs cart/caching).

Inc-0008 reports duplicate push notifications for shipments. Inc-0050 reports incorrect currency label in price-drop push notifications. These are different push notification issues with different symptoms (duplication vs wrong label).

Inc-0009 (Spanish) and Inc-0010 (English) both describe the same defect: the 'Save' button on the Spanish profile page remains untranslated in English. Same feature, same location, same untranslated string.

Inc-0009 reports untranslated 'Save' button on profile page. Inc-0037 reports untranslated login error message. Both are translation issues but in different features (profile vs login), so different defects.

Inc-0010 reports untranslated 'Save' button on profile page. Inc-0037 reports untranslated login error message. Both are translation issues but in different features and different UI elements, so different defects.

First incident reports untranslated 'Save' button on Spanish profile page; second reports truncated product titles with no tooltip. These are completely different defects in different areas of the app.

First incident describes app crashing when opening orders with 100+ orders; second provides the exact technical root cause (IndexOutOfBoundsException at index 100). These describe the same failure from user and technical perspectives.

First incident reports app crash opening order history for users with 100+ orders; second reports order list closing the app for a heavy user. Both describe the same crash behavior on the order history screen.

First incident reports app crash on order history screen; second reports missing webhooks for order.created events. These are unrelated defects affecting different systems (mobile app vs. backend integration).

First incident is Android app crash on order history; second is iOS app crash on payment step with saved card. Different platforms, different screens, different triggering actions—completely different defects.
First incident reports app crash when opening order history; second reports missing cancellation emails. These affect different features (mobile UI vs. email system) with no relationship.
First incident reports app crash on order history; second reports search autocomplete lag on older iPhones. Completely different features and defects affecting different parts of the app.

First incident reports order history crash on Android; second reports truncated product titles with no tooltip on web. Different platforms (Android vs. web), different features (order history vs. product grid), different defects.
First is the technical error log (IndexOutOfBoundsException) for order history crash; second is user report of order list closing the app. Both describe the same crash on order history screen.

First (English) reports order list closing the app for a heavy user; second (Spanish) reports order history appearing empty for many users since database migration. These describe different failures: one is a crash, the other is missing/empty data after migration.
inc-0013 reports a crash when opening order history on the mobile app; inc-0027 reports incorrect prices displayed in the app. These are completely different defects in different features.

Both reports describe blurry/pixelated product images on tablets. inc-0014 specifies iPad Pro with app 4.1.3, inc-0015 describes Galaxy Tab. Both suggest loading a thumbnail instead of full resolution image - same defect on different tablet devices.

inc-0014 reports pixelated product images on iPad (resolution/thumbnail loading issue); inc-0033 reports slow image loading on 3G (performance issue). These are different defects - one is about image quality, the other about loading speed.

inc-0014 reports pixelated/blurry product images on iPad; inc-0051 reports truncated product titles with no tooltip on web. These affect different UI elements (images vs titles) in different contexts.
inc-0015 reports blurry product images on tablets; inc-0032 reports missing size table on mobile web in product details. These are different defects in different components/screens.
Both reports describe slow search in the app (6-8 seconds) versus fast on web. inc-0016 provides specific timing metrics, inc-0017 is a general complaint. Same defect with different levels of detail.

Both describe slow app search (6-8 seconds). inc-0016 is user-facing report, inc-0018 is technical analysis revealing the root cause (wrong search index used). Same observable defect reported from different perspectives.
inc-0016 reports slow search in app; inc-0027 reports incorrect prices in app. These are different defects in different features, though both affect the app.
inc-0016 reports slow search results (6-8 seconds); inc-0033 reports slow image loading (10+ seconds on 3G). Both are performance issues but in different features/components.
inc-0016 reports slow search in mobile app on 4G; inc-0035 reports slow customer search in admin panel. Different features in different parts of the system (mobile app vs admin backend).

inc-0016 reports slow search on mobile app (6-8s) with 4G. inc-0049 reports autocomplete lag on older iPhones (1s per keystroke). Different symptoms: results latency vs keystroke input lag on specific devices.

Both report slow search in the app vs fast on web. inc-0017 is user complaint about slow searches. inc-0018 provides technical detail: /search endpoint is 7.8s on app vs 300ms on web due to app not using new index. Same defect.
inc-0017 reports slow search loading in app. inc-0027 reports incorrect old pricing in app. Different features: search performance vs product pricing. Not duplicates.
inc-0017 reports slow search in app. inc-0033 reports slow product image loading on 3G. Different components: search performance vs image loading performance.
inc-0017 reports slow search in mobile app. inc-0035 reports slow customer search in admin panel. Different products/interfaces: user app vs admin panel. Not duplicates.
inc-0017 reports slow search results loading (6-8s) in app. inc-0049 reports autocomplete keystroke lag (1s per key) on iPhones. Different defects: results loading vs input responsiveness.
inc-0018 reports slow /search endpoint (7.8s) on app mobile. inc-0033 reports slow product image loading (10s) on 3G. Different components: search endpoint vs image asset loading.
inc-0018 reports slow /search endpoint in mobile app (7.8s). inc-0035 reports slow customer search in admin panel (15s). Different products: user app vs admin interface.
inc-0018 reports slow /search endpoint response on mobile app. inc-0043 reports search results showing unavailable products by region. Different defects: performance vs incorrect result filtering.
inc-0018 reports slow /search endpoint (7.8s response) on mobile app. inc-0049 reports autocomplete keystroke lag on iPhones. Different symptoms: endpoint latency vs UI input responsiveness.
Both reports describe the same defect: password reset emails not arriving for Outlook/Hotmail users. Inc-0020 is a specific user experience of the broader issue described in inc-0019.

Inc-0019 reports password reset emails not arriving for Outlook/Hotmail users. Inc-0045 reports that changing account email in the profile shows 'Saved' but doesn't update. These are different defects in different features.

Inc-0019 reports password reset emails not arriving for Outlook/Hotmail users. Inc-0047 reports order cancellation emails not being sent at all. These are different email-related defects affecting different email types.
Inc-0020 reports not receiving password reset emails via Outlook. Inc-0045 reports account email not being saved in the profile. These are different defects in different features.

Both reports describe the same defect: saved addresses being duplicated when edited instead of being updated. Inc-0021 is in Spanish (web), inc-0022 is in Spanish (Android app), but both describe identical behavior across platforms.

Both reports describe the same defect: webhook delivery for order.created events is missing/empty. Inc-0023 reports it from partner perspective, inc-0024 reports it from internal monitoring perspective with deployment correlation.

Inc-0023 reports missing order.created webhooks. Inc-0026 reports empty order history after database migration affecting thousands of users. While both involve orders, one is a webhook delivery issue and the other is a data visibility issue—these are different defects.
Inc-0023 reports missing order.created webhooks. Inc-0047 reports order cancellation emails not being sent. These are different notification mechanisms affected by potentially different issues.

Inc-0024 reports webhook delivery queue empty for order.created events. Inc-0031 reports admin button to mark orders as sent giving an error. These are different defects in different systems (webhooks vs. admin UI).

Inc-0025 reports blank page at shipping step with a TypeError reading 'zones'. Inc-0031 reports admin button to mark orders as sent giving an error. These are different defects in different areas (customer checkout vs. admin operations).

inc-0025 reports a blank screen with a TypeError during checkout shipping step affecting all platforms. inc-0039 reports missing accents in Spanish text on the same checkout page. These are different defects: one is a critical crash, the other is a UI/localization issue.

inc-0026 reports empty order history for thousands of users post-migration affecting data retrieval. inc-0030 reports cart emptying on logout, a different cart-persistence issue. Different features and different root causes.

inc-0026 reports empty order history post-migration affecting customer-facing order data. inc-0031 reports admin button error for marking orders as shipped. Different features (customer view vs admin function) requiring different fixes.

inc-0026 reports missing order history data post-migration. inc-0034 reports sales report excluding coupon orders. Both follow the migration but affect different systems; one is customer-facing data loss, the other is reporting logic.

inc-0027 reports stale price in app vs web with correct charge. inc-0050 reports push notification showing USD instead of MXN. Both are price display issues but in different contexts (app product vs notifications) and different problems.

inc-0031 reports admin button error for marking orders shipped. inc-0034 reports sales report not including coupon orders. Both admin issues but different features: one affects order status updates, the other affects reporting calculations.

inc-0031 reports admin button error for marking orders shipped. inc-0039 reports missing accents in checkout text. Completely different features (order management vs UI localization) on different parts of the system.

inc-0031 reports admin button error when marking orders shipped. inc-0043 reports search showing unavailable regional products. Unrelated features: admin order management vs search filtering/regional logic.
inc-0031 reports admin button error marking orders shipped. inc-0047 reports missing cancellation email when support cancels orders. Different systems: admin UI vs email notification system.

inc-0033 reports slow product image loading on 3G in the app catalog. inc-0058 reports slow category page load on web with 50 Mbps. Same symptom (slow initial load) but different platforms, different specific causes, and different contexts.
inc-0035 reports slow customer search in admin (15 seconds), while inc-0046 reports incorrect UTC timezone display in admin order list. These are different defects in different admin features.

inc-0038 reports logo stretching in email Outlook rendering, while inc-0039 reports missing accents in Spanish text ('Dirección de envío') on web checkout. These are different defects in different features and environments.

inc-0038 reports a stretched logo in email Outlook rendering, while inc-0056 reports misaligned payment card brand logos on web payment step. These are different visual sizing issues in different environments and features.

inc-0039 reports missing accents in Spanish text ('Dirección de envío') in checkout, while inc-0043 reports search results showing US-only products to Mexican users. These are different defects with different root causes.

inc-0039 reports missing accents in Spanish ('Dirección de envío') and inc-0054 reports an English typo ('Adress' instead of 'Address'). Both are text/label errors in the shipping form section of checkout, describing the same defective feature requiring text corrections.

inc-0040 reports left-aligned amounts in admin tables making them hard to compare, while inc-0046 reports UTC timezone display in admin order list. These are different UI/data display issues in different admin areas.
inc-0040 reports left-aligned amounts in admin tables, while inc-0053 reports a misaligned sidebar icon. These are different layout/alignment issues in different admin components.

inc-0043 reports search showing region-unavailable products for Mexican users, while inc-0050 reports push notifications showing USD instead of MXN currency. These are different localization/regional issues in different features.
inc-0043 reports search results showing region-unavailable products, while inc-0051 reports long product titles being truncated with no tooltip. These are different defects in product display/search.

inc-0044 reports iOS app crash when selecting a saved card (EXC_BAD_ACCESS), while inc-0059 reports expired saved cards being accepted until final payment attempt. These are different defects: a crash versus insufficient validation.

Report 1 describes a timezone display issue in admin order lists (UTC vs Mexico City time). Report 2 describes a currency label mismatch in push notifications (USD label for MXN prices). These are different defects in different features.

Report 1 describes inconsistent logo sizing on the payment step (Visa larger than others). Report 2 describes acceptance of expired saved cards without validation until final payment. These are different defects: one is a UI styling issue, the other is a validation/security issue.
